user_query: I want to integrate real-time cryptocurrency price data into my application.

TaskList.description: Search for APIs that provide real-time cryptocurrency price data, including options for multiple cryptocurrencies.
Select an appropriate API from the list found in Step 1 that meets the requirement of real-time price data.
Retrieve real-time price data for multiple cryptocurrencies using the selected API.
Query the selected API to obtain the trading volume and price of Bitcoin on different exchanges.
